title: StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex measurable set Q; f is convex and continuously differentiable on E, and ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: objective; spec.admissible convexity and minimizer clauses.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines a differentiable function f with a possibly nonsmooth convex term ψ, handled through an exact composite Bregman proximal oracle.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Instance, objective, proxObjective; spec.admissible proximal minimization clause.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A gradient query at x∈Q returns a dual vector g(x,ξ), with E[g(x,ξ)]=df(x). Seeds are independent and identically distributed. Only gradient and proximal queries are available.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Query; spec.admissible oracle and unbiasedness clauses. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, z∈Q∩U and dual vector v, the oracle returns an exact minimizer over Q of a(v(u−z)+ψ(u))+D_h(u,z), lying in Q∩U. Gradient and proximal calls share one fixed total oracle budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Query.prox, proxObjective; spec.admissible proximal clause. LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.numOracles, executeWithTrace, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public L0>0 and L1≥0 satisfy ‖df(x)−df(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖ whenever ‖df‖≤M along the segment from x to y. No global Lipschitz gradient bound is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Public.L0, Public.L1; spec.valid and spec.admissible segment smoothness clause.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public σ≥0 and 1<α≤2 bound the central dual-norm moment: E‖g(x,ξ)−df(x)‖^α≤σ^α for every x∈Q. Finite variance is not required when α<2.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Public.σ, Public.α; spec.valid and spec.admissible moment clauses.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: E has an arbitrary norm, with gradients in its continuous dual. The differentiable mirror function h satisfies D_h(u,z)≥‖u−z‖²/2 for z∈Q∩U and u∈Q; U is open and convex. No bounded domain or upper bound on Bregman divergence is imposed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Public, Dual, divergence; spec.admissible geometry clauses.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real normed space with its Borel measurable structure; no inner-product structure is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All numerical parameters and x0 are public. A common minimizer x⋆ satisfies D_h(x⋆,x0)≤R²/2, F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ and ‖df(x⋆)‖≤G, with R,Δ>0 and G≥0. The functions, feasible set, mirror function and minimizer are hidden instance data.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: Public, Instance; spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible initialization clause.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable output x with F(x)−F(x⋆)≤ε, where ε>0 and x⋆ minimizes F over Q. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output must belong to Q on the success event.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: For public 0<δ<1, P{x∉Q or F(x)−F(x⋆)>ε}≤δ, over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedMirror.lean: spec.valid, spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence joint probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines gradient-dependent generalized smoothness, finite central α-moment noise, composite Bregman proximal geometry in an arbitrary finite-dimensional norm, and a high-probability feasible objective-gap guarantee.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Generalized Smooth Composite Minimization

We consider minimizing F=f+ψ over a convex set Q in a finite-dimensional real normed space E. The function f:E→R is convex and (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1≥0, and ψ:E→R is convex on Q. A given starting point has bounded objective gap and Bregman divergence to a minimizer x⋆∈Q. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic derivatives with independent samples and bounded αth error moments, 1<α≤2, or exact Bregman proximal points. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯ satisfying x¯∈Q and F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε with probability at least 1−δ.

The optimization problem is minx∈QF(x),F(x)=f(x)+ψ(x). Write E∗ for the continuous dual of E, equipped with its induced operator norm ∥⋅∥op. Let Ω be the measurable sample space. The algorithm receives E, Ω, the starting point x0, and the parameters L0>0,L1≥0,R>0,Δ>0,G≥0,σ≥0,1<α≤2,ε>0,0<δ<1. The instance supplies the objective and proximal geometry through the oracle described below.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and generalized smoothness). The function f is convex and Fréchet differentiable on E, with continuous derivative df:E→E∗. For every x,y∈E and M∈R, ∥df(x+θ(y−x))∥op≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1]⟹∥df(x)−df(y)∥op≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥. The set Q⊆E is convex and Borel measurable. The function ψ is measurable on E and convex on Q.

Assumption 2 (Bregman geometry and exact proximal access). There is an open convex set U⊆E and a function h:E→R that is Fréchet differentiable on U. For z∈U and u∈E, define Dh(u,z)=h(u)−h(z)−dh(z)[u−z]. The divergence satisfies Dh(u,z)≥12∥u−z∥2,z∈Q∩U,u∈Q. An exact proximal map T:R×E×E∗→E is supplied. For every a>0, z∈Q∩U, and v∈E∗, T(a,z,v)∈Q∩U,T(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{a(v[u−z]+ψ(u))+Dh(u,z)}. The map on R×E×E∗ given by (a,z,v)⟼{T(a,z,v),a>0,x0,a≤0 is measurable.

Assumption 3 (Initial bounds and a minimizer). The given point satisfies x0∈Q∩U. There exists x⋆∈Q such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,Dh(x⋆,x0)≤R2/2,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ,∥df(x⋆)∥op≤G.

Assumption 4 (Stochastic derivative oracle). There is a probability measure μ on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E∗. For every x∈Q, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable, the random variable ∥g(x,ξ)−df(x)∥opα is integrable for ξ∼μ, and Eξ∼μ[g(x,ξ)]=df(x),Eξ∼μ[∥g(x,ξ)−df(x)∥opα]≤σα. The sample sequence (ξk)k≥0 has a joint probability law ν on ΩN under which its coordinates are measurable, mutually independent, and each distributed according to μ. This sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness. At call k, a derivative query at x∈E returns g(x,ξk); a proximal query (a,z,v)∈R×E×E∗ returns T(a,z,v).

Both types of query count toward the same total oracle-call budget. The output x¯∈E must be measurable and satisfy P(x¯∉Q or F(x¯)−F(x⋆)>ε)≤δ, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the sample sequence.

comparisonHtml:
Minimize F=f+ψ over convex measurable Q in a finite-dimensional normed space. The globally convex differentiable f has continuous derivative and satisfies ∥df(x)−df(y)∥∗≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥df(z)∥∗)∥x−y∥ on the whole space. The measurable ψ is convex on Q. A differentiable mirror map on open convex U satisfies Dh(u,z)≥∥u−z∥2/2 for u∈Q, z∈Q∩U; measurable exact composite Bregman-prox updates stay in Q∩U, and x0∈Q∩U. A minimizer x∗∈Q satisfies 2Dh(x∗,x0)≤R2, F(x0)−F(x∗)≤Δ, ∥df(x∗)∥∗≤G. Jointly measurable stochastic gradients use IID samples with law μ under probability P, with integrable gradients and central moments, ∫g(x,ω)dμ=df(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−df(x)∥∗αdμ≤σα on Q. Here L0,R,Δ,ε>0, L1,G,σ≥0, 1<α≤2, 0<δ<1. All displayed parameters are supplied to (1). Target: the constructed algorithm’s lastIterate satisfies P{x∉Q or F(x)−F(x∗)>ε}≤δ.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMirror

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  x0 : E
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.finiteE
  Public.measurableE Public.borelE Public.measurableΩ

abbrev Dual (q : Public) := q.E →L[ℝ] ℝ

noncomputable instance (q : Public) : MeasurableSpace (Dual q) := borel _

instance (q : Public) : BorelSpace (Dual q) := ⟨rfl⟩

inductive Query (q : Public) where
  | gradient (x : q.E)
  | prox (a : ℝ) (z : q.E) (v : Dual q)

abbrev Reply (q : Public) := Dual q ⊕ q.E

structure Instance (q : Public) where
  f : q.E → ℝ
  df : q.E → Dual q
  ψ : q.E → ℝ
  Q : Set q.E
  h : q.E → ℝ
  dh : q.E → Dual q
  U : Set q.E
  prox : ℝ → q.E → Dual q → q.E

def objective {q : Public} (I : Instance q) (x : q.E) : ℝ := I.f x + I.ψ x

def divergence {q : Public} (I : Instance q) (u z : q.E) : ℝ :=
  I.h u - I.h z - I.dh z (u - z)

def proxObjective {q : Public} (I : Instance q) (a : ℝ) (z : q.E) (v : Dual q)
    (u : q.E) : ℝ := a * (v (u - z) + I.ψ u) + divergence I u z

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Public
  Public := Public
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply := Reply
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧
    0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 1 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 2 ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → Dual q) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (μ : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, query) seed => match query with
            | .gradient x => Sum.inl (g x seed)
            | .prox a z v => Sum.inr (I.prox a z v) } ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ univ I.f ∧ (∀ x, HasFDerivAt I.f (I.df x) x) ∧ Continuous I.df ∧
    (∀ x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖I.df (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖I.df x - I.df y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    Convex ℝ I.Q ∧ MeasurableSet I.Q ∧ ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ ∧ Measurable I.ψ ∧
    IsOpen I.U ∧ Convex ℝ I.U ∧
    (∀ z ∈ I.U, HasFDerivAt I.h (I.dh z) z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ I.Q ∩ I.U, ∀ u ∈ I.Q, ‖u - z‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ divergence I u z) ∧
    Measurable (fun t : ℝ × q.E × Dual q =>
      if 0 < t.1 then I.prox t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2 else q.x0) ∧
    (∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z ∈ I.Q ∩ I.U, ∀ v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∩ I.U ∧
      IsMinOn (proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)) ∧
    q.x0 ∈ I.Q ∩ I.U ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      divergence I xstar q.x0 ≤ q.R ^ 2 / 2 ∧
      objective I q.x0 - objective I xstar ≤ q.Δ ∧ ‖I.df xstar‖ ≤ q.G) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.Q, Integrable (g x) (μ : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.Q, (∫ ω, g x ω ∂(μ : Measure _)) = I.df x) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.Q, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - I.df x‖ ^ q.α) (μ : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.Q, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - I.df x‖ ^ q.α ∂(μ : Measure _)) ≤ q.σ ^ q.α)
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | output ω ∉ I.Q ∨
        q.ε < objective I (output ω) - objective I xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedMirror
